2607.12462.title: Do We Really Need Transformers for Global Spatial Information Extraction in Traffic Forecasting?
2607.12462.paper_summary: Existing traffic forecasting models commonly focus on extracting spatial dependencies, particularly global spatial information, which characterizes the representations obtained through interactions between each individual node and all nodes across the traffic network. However, the underlying mechanism by which such global information is modeled and extracted remains insufficiently investigated. Whether global information must be extracted by high-degree-of-freedom adaptive attention or can be captured by a simple global aggregation operator remains unclear. For this purpose, we design a controlled ablation framework that replaces only the spatial mixing module to test attention-based global interaction. Across six traffic benchmarks, uniform full-range mixing and standard spatial attention each achieve lower MAE on three datasets, with only a 0.14% difference in mean MAE, while the former reduces node-scale spatial mixing complexity from O(N2) to O(N). Mechanism analysis further decomposes spatial attention into a row-uniform global background and a non-uniform residual. The residual shows dataset-dependent marginal value, suggesting that spatial attention should be justified by stable gains beyond a row-uniform global background. The corresponding source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/uuesti/U-Trans
2607.12462.paper_summary_zh: 現有的交通預測模型通常專注於提取空間依賴性，特別是全球空間信息，這特徵化了通過每個單獨節點與交通網絡中所有節點之間的互動所獲得的表示。<lb/>然而，這種全球信息的建模和提取的潛在機制仍然未被充分研究。<lb/>全球信息是否必須通過高自由度的自適應注意力來提取，或者可以通過簡單的全球聚合運算符來捕捉，仍然不清楚。<lb/>為此，我們設計了一個控制性消融框架，僅替換空間混合模塊以測試基於注意力的全球互動。<lb/>在六個交通基準測試中，均勻全範圍混合和標準空間注意力在三個數據集上均達到較低的平均絕對誤差（MAE），其平均 MAE 之間的差異僅為 0.14%，而前者將節點規模的空間混合複雜性從 O(N2) 降低到 O(N)。<lb/>機制分析進一步將空間注意力分解為行均勻的全球背景和非均勻的殘差。<lb/>殘差顯示出數據集依賴的邊際價值，這表明空間注意力應該通過超越行均勻全球背景的穩定增益來證明其合理性。<lb/>相應的源代碼可在以下網址公開獲得：https://github.com/uuesti/U-Trans
